Metrics.Title: Automation overview
Metrics.NoSession: Start AutoDuty to collect session metrics. Existing completion logs are available below.
Metrics.Definition: 100% requires every applicable step from the start and confirmed duty completion, without failures, stuck recovery, or manual intervention. The uninterrupted step count freezes at the first problem. Script-defined optional skips are counted separately as resolved steps.
Metrics.Exported: Report copied. Character identity is removed; a pseudonymous contributor ID remains.
Metrics.ReportsNote: Reports share measurements, not route scripts. Imported measurements are contributor-reported evidence; duplicate run IDs are ignored. Turn off 'This session only' to compare history and shared reports.
Metrics.Coverage: Level 16–100 coverage for the current configuration
Metrics.NoData: No completed attempt samples yet. Failed and stopped attempts become samples too.
Metrics.ComparisonNote: Groups separate route content hash, job, duty mode, party size and multibox mode. XP/hour here uses in-duty attempt time, including failed attempts; it excludes queues. Use session XP/hour for end-to-end leveling efficiency.
Metrics.CoverageNote: Uses the current character, job, unlocks, leveling filters and selected routes for levels 16–99; level 100 is the goal. Samples must match the current route content and duty/multibox mode. Samples must also match the current party size. A candidate means enough observed clean samples, not a guarantee of unattended leveling. Coverage uses all history, regardless of the session filter.
